chunks: Al-Hasan al-Sayqal asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
about the muhrim whose molar is causing him pain: can he have it extracted?
He said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim in ihram have a painful tooth extracted?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim in ihram who is harmed by tooth pain. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام permits extraction of the tooth, indicating that necessary treatment to remove harm is allowed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2653 - Al-Hasan al-Sayqal asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a Muhrim whose tooth is causing him pain: "Can he have it extracted?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."
